_meta.description: Atomic constraint units actually evaluated. Compound LogicQA bullets are split where clause-level taxonomy differs, so that each unit yields a single binary verdict.
_meta.split_policy: Multi-aspect bullets split where clause-level taxonomy differs. 5 bullets split: BB-L1→kept, SC-L1→a/b, JB-L1→a/b, JB-L2→a/b/c, JB-L3→a/b. BB-L3 added from existing GT.

taxonomy.range-based: continuous measurable quantity verified against a range/threshold
taxonomy.composition/property: property binding — attribute bound to object independently, type-based masking
taxonomy.composition/relational: relational binding — spatial relationship across object roles, role-aware masking

_meta.reference_labels_note: taxonomy/binding here are reference annotations for inspection only. At run time the pipeline re-derives them from the constraint text (cascade/parse.py, Stage 1), and the derived value may differ.

units.text: The breakfast box contains exactly two tangerines and one nectarine.
The ratio and relative position of the cereals and the mix of banana chips and almonds on the right-hand side are fixed.
The right compartment contains cereal and a mix of banana chips and almonds.
A screw bag contains exactly two washers, two nuts, one long screw, and one short screw.
The long screw and the short screw are each longer than 3 times the diameter of the washer.
Each compartment of the box of pushpins contains exactly one pushpin.
Exactly two splicing connectors are linked by exactly one cable.
The two splicing connectors have the same number of cable clamps.
The number of clamps has a one-to-one correspondence to the {color} of the cable.
The cable connects to the same slot index on both the left connector and the right connector.
The cable length is roughly longer than the length of the splicing connector terminal block.
The juice bottle is filled with {fruit} juice.
The juice bottle carries exactly two labels.
The fruit icon label is attached to the center of the bottle.
The {fruit} icon is positioned exactly at the center of the fruit icon label.
The {fruit} icon clearly indicates the type of {fruit} juice.
The text label is attached to the lower part of the bottle.
The juice fills at least 90% of the bottle, but not 100%.
